project_type: Data repository with YAML model files and Python scripts for validation/extraction
build_system: pip install for dependencies, no build step
build_command: pip install pyyaml jsonschema requests beautifulsoup4 markdownify
verification_instructions: Run python3 scripts/validate.py to ensure all model YAML files pass JSON Schema validation
setup_instructions: pip install pyyaml jsonschema requests beautifulsoup4 markdownify
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available. LLM API available at ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic with ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=ac96a781bad141808246da37f274d99a.1w0Oib3gCblk4rC3 and ANTHROPIC_MODEL=glm-4.5-air
contribution_requirements: YAML files must pass schema validation via validate.py. Domain field must match folder name.
key_patterns: extract_yaml.py reads .md file, builds prompt with schema field definitions injected, calls LLM API, parses YAML output, validates against schema, writes .yaml file. The script skips files with <100 char MD content.
directory_structure: domains/{category-name}/{model-name}.yaml + {model-name}.md pairs, 20 domain categories, 76 model files currently
